messages:
maya: :wave: Hi everyone — I’m Maya (joined today, infra). Quick question: who "owns" the model-validation area (alerting, rollout gating, test suites)? Also where’s the canonical ownership map so I know who to ping for approvals?
olivia: welcome Maya! :tada: People Ops has onboarding stuff but the ownership map lives in two places: `infra/OWNERS` in the repo and Confluence -> Org -> Ownership. If you need a fast ping for infra approvals, tag @raj.
raj: hey @maya — i own model-validation on the infra side (prod). Owners are listed in `infra/OWNERS` with team emails. For rollouts: follow the canary policy and add me on the PR if it touches prod configs. For urgency, ping #eng-oncall and tag @sam.
sam: +1. Oncall is first responder. If it’s an incident, follow the runbook: `/runbooks/model-validation.md`. PagerDuty rotation: https://pd.redwood.example/rotations. Quick tip to find owners locally: `git grep -n \"model-validation\" infra/OWNERS` or `rg \"model-validation\" infra/OWNERS`.
maya: thanks — super helpful. Is there a standard canary progression or SLA I should follow before promoting a change to all traffic?
raj: yes — our default is canary 5% -> 20% -> 100% with 1 hour observation windows between steps (shorter windows can be used for low-risk changes). We also require automated smoke tests to pass during each step. The policy doc is at Confluence -> Runtime -> Canary Policy.
maya: great. For approvals, do I need to open a ticket or email a list?
olivia: approvals: send a short email to infra-approvals@redwood.com with PR link + one-line risk summary. CC your manager and me if you want a People Ops record. For security-sensitive changes include the sec-review label on the PR.
maya: perfect — last quick one: is there a recommended list of people to CC for inference model config changes?
sam: there’s a notification matrix on the Runtime Change Playbook in Confluence — it lists who to CC by tier (prod-data-impact, perf-impact, privacy). When in doubt, mention #eng-runtime and tag the SRE lead.
raj: FYI @maya I’ll add you to the `model-validation` entry in `infra/OWNERS` so you can be requested as reviewer/approver on PRs. I’ll DM the repo path.
devex-bot: @maya has been added to infra/OWNERS (team: model-validation) — welcome! :sparkles:
maya: thank you all — this is exactly what I needed. I’ll read the runbook and canary policy and open the PR for the change I’m working on. Appreciate the quick pointers.
